newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices firmer at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices firmer at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices firmed at the weekly auction in Mombasa supported by very strong demand, auction officials said.
Brighter and medium BP1s were 8-14 U.S. cents dearer while lower mediums were irregular. Brighter and medium PF1s gained 10-19 cents while liquoring mediums went up by 15 cents.
Brighter DUST1s gained 3-9 cents, while most descriptions in the secondary catalogues were dearer.
There was very strong demand from Pakistan while Egypt and the Bazaar remained forceful. Britain followed quality.
